blurb: Guests charter the Sea Ray 440 yacht named Bella for private excursions including sunset cruises, ocean cruises, and trips to Catalina Island. The boat is US Coast Guard approved and legal for charter, with safety equipment and annual inspections. Guests can bring their own food and adult drinks (21+), with some restrictions on red liquids.
